Compared names, motivation, status, lifespan, award year, historical institutional name/city/country and original-record hash. Award-year relevance is explicit context, not year-long employment. All other listed cities fit their dated framework envelopes. countryNow, birthplace and nationality are unused. Occupied/dependent associations do not assert sovereignty or regime endorsement. Different announcement years and unmatched frameworks remain held in acquisition records. Non-Nobel people and non-award years remain explicit gaps.
